resources.string: A small route. An exact sum.

Start at S. Tap a cell next to the end of your path: up, down, left or right. Every visited number, including S and F, adds to your sum. Collect every ◆ key and reach F with the exact target. You can leave other cells unused. A cell can be visited only once. Any path that follows these rules wins. Undo removes one step; Restart clears the route. Puzzles and progress work offline.
The same puzzle stays. Only your steps will be removed.
Your unfinished route will be replaced by a new puzzle at the same difficulty.
First steps has shorter routes and one key. Winding paths adds longer routes and two keys. Deep routes uses a larger board and three keys. Every puzzle has a solution.

One shared puzzle per calendar day. No timer. Your route is kept when you leave.

This day’s puzzle is already counted in your progress.
1 · Begin at S. Its number is already in your sum. Tap the highlighted neighbour.
2 · Every new cell adds its number. Follow the highlighted neighbour and watch the sum.
3 · A ◆ is a required key. Visit its cell to collect it.
4 · Reach F with every key and the exact sum. Tap the highlighted finish.
You’ve got it. A real puzzle can have several winning routes. Try First steps next.
